DARSHANIM.Sync.Interdit: DAS · Animations: enable the BLFX setting "BLFX Custom Auto-Rec Updates" (Boss Loot module settings), then reload. It lets this module add its animations to the Custom Auto-Rec; your own entries are kept.
DARSHANIM.Sync.Problemes: DAS · Animations: {n} animation(s) could not be sent to BLFX — see the console for details.
DARSHANIM.Sync.Echec: DAS · Animations: BLFX did not confirm the Custom Auto-Rec import — see the console for details.
DARSHANIM.Settings.Renderer.Name: Effect renderer
DARSHANIM.Settings.Renderer.Hint: How the effects this module plays itself are shown — potions and consumables (a potion drunk or administered, a poison applied, a flask thrown, a scroll read, food and drink) and traps. Auto: Boss Loot (BLFX), otherwise Token Magic FX, otherwise a built-in coloured ring (green: beneficial, red: harmful, blue: neutral). A renderer that is not installed falls back to the next one.
DARSHANIM.Settings.Renderer.Auto: Auto (BLFX, then Token Magic FX, then built-in)
